To elucidate the role of iDMI in determining the static characteristics of skyrmions in SAF nanostrips, we conduct micromagnetic simulations by systematically varying the iDMI strength from 1 mJ/m² to 4 mJ/m² in 0.1 mJ/m² steps.

extra_quotes: An open-source GPU-accelerated micromagnetic simulator, mumax 3,42,43 is employed to compute the magnetization dynamics of magnetic skyrmion based on the Landau –Lifshitz– Gilbert (LLG) equation.44,45 Utilizing the finite-difference method, it solves the LLG equation numerically to yield micromagnetic simulation results.

All micromagnetic simulations are conducted at 0 K, with thermal fluctuations disregarded. This method enables the isolation of the inherent effects of SOT, RKKY coupling, and iDMI on the stability and dynamics of SAF skyrmions without the need for extra stochastic contributions.

The current work focuses on the deterministic dynamics of SAF skyrmions at 0 K in perfect defect -free structures. Thermal fluctuations may affect the long -term transport behavior, depinning thresholds, deformation, and stability of the skyrmions.
